originating_session_goal: Complete Ecosystem Chat and VA Claim Assistant as fully functional, continuously extensible public entry points while preventing false archival and duplicate execution.
requirements_transferred: Neither entry point may be represented as 100 percent intended without end-to-end activation evidence.
A handoff does not transfer work; transfer requires a bounded accepted claim and observable execution evidence.
Claims must expire or renew through new evidence and must not remain indefinite.
Duplicate implementation must be prevented through collision boundaries and canonical task ownership.
Archival is prohibited while unique active work, unsupported claims, or incomplete archival-dependent tasks remain.
Ecosystem Chat requires provider use, persistence, custody, reconstruction, Site activation, and downstream propagation.
VA Claim Assistant requires source grounding, document awareness, provenance, TVC capability, custody, reconstruction, and exact public status.
remaining_session_role: Observe and reconcile bounded claims until unique validation or consolidation responsibility is completed or actually transferred.
